newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil gains over $3, heat buying improves.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil gains over $3, heat buying improves.

text.p: NWE gas oil shot up by over $3 a tonne as sharply higher futures combined with firmer premiums, traders said. Activity was much improved from Monday.
May IPE gas oil closed $3.00 a tonne higher at $169.00 on a combination of healthy buying and strong NYMEX products.
Heating oil regained the gas oil podium because of the absence of diesel on offer, traders said.
Three DIN cargoes were sold all destined for Hamburg. One at May IPE +$6.50 cif, another at May IPE +$6.75 cif and the third at May IPE +50 cents fob ARA.
Diesel cargoes attracted bids of May IPE +$13.50 cif NWE with offers going as high as May IPE +$15.00 cif. Traders said tight supply underpinned the market.
"Its quiet for lack of offers, not because no one is interested," said one trader.
Russian and FOD were little talked, but market players said premiums had notionally firmed $1 or so in line with the overall stronger tone.
